content.en: Scientists have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict various pharmacokinetic parameters in drug development. These algorithms, such as DemQSAR and machine learning models, are being used to predict human volume of distribution, clearance, pharmacokinetics, and other important drug properties. By integrating computational methods and in vitro data, researchers hope to improve the efficiency and accuracy of drug discovery and development processes.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige farmakokinetiske parametre i lægemiddeludvikling. Disse algoritmer, såsom DemQSAR og machine learning-modeller, anvendes til at forudsige menneskelig distributionsvolumen, clearance, farmakokinetik og andre vigtige lægemiddel egenskaber. Ved at integrere beregningsmetoder og in vitro data håber forskerne at forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden af lægemiddelopdagelse og udviklingsprocesser.

critic.en:
Pharmacokinetic prediction through algorithms is like handing over the holy grail of drug development to machines. Imagine the potential for misdiagnosis and error propagation. 

Have you noticed how often the digital "revolution" seems to assume that throwing AI and algorithms at a problem is an unmitigated good?
critic.da:
Ah, here we go again. Yet another attempt to reduce complexity to a set of "smart" algorithms. 
 

 Take a look at the reality of our AI systems today. Even now, they are riddled with biases, errors and unintended consequences. From facial recognition systems that perpetuate racial biases to language models that spread misinformation and reinforce harmful stereotypes—AI has  shown that its "intelligence" can often amplify the problems it was intended to solve. And yet, now we want to put our trust in these systems to make decisions about our health?

potential.en: I am thrilled to hear about the use of technology in pharmacokinetic prediction! It is amazing how far we have come in the field of drug development. By combining computational methods and in vitro data, researchers can now make more accurate predictions about important drug properties. This not only speeds up the drug discovery process but also ensures the development of safer and more effective medications. I am excited to see how these algorithms will continue to evolve and make a real impact in healthcare.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan teknologi og digitalisering spiller en så stor rolle i udviklingen af nye lægemidler! Ved at bruge algoritmer og maskinlæring kan forskere forudsige vigtige parametre og dermed forbedre effektiviteten og nøjagtigheden i hele processen. Jeg er overbevist om, at denne tilgang vil føre til hurtigere godkendelser af nye behandlinger og forbedre sundheden for mange mennesker.
